name: Shatanaya's Frostsilver: Muzzle
desc: Blueprint for a firearm accessory that can be used to create said inscribed weapon accessory by consuming materials in the Eye of Graeae's HUD.

value.text:
When using a Normal Attack, gain 1 stack of
Skymirror's Sight, which grants a 1%
Cryo DMG Bonus and Physical DMG Bonus. This effect lasts 2s. Max 50 stacks. When you have more than 2
Skymirror's Sight stacks, your Normal Attacks will deal
Cryo DMG instead.
Go to "Meeting Point: Huntsman's Cabin" to unlock
